text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After school. Daring Heart bounced 
cheerfully into the trainer's room.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Do you have some time after 
this?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The legendary shark movie—"Metallic 
Shark"! I found it in a bargain bin at a 
thrift store!
choice_data_list:
Is that what you were talking about the 
other day?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! A metallic shark attacks the beach... 
It's a cult classic shark movie for those 
in the know!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The DVD is out of print and it's streaming 
nowhere! To think I can actually see it 
with my own eyes...!
choice_data_list:
Ahaha. You really do love shark movies, 
don't you?
Ahaha. You truly love shark movies, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Shark movies aren't just your 
run-of-the-mill disaster flicks, you know—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
She's the guiding light that changed my 
entire outlook on life!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Goodness, a tiger shark, you say? If 
attacked by those sharp teeth, one 
wouldn't stand a chance."

text_block_list.name: Young Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe, it's okay, Mama. They won't chase 
me across the sea, after all."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
――"Sharks belong in the ocean." That was 
common sense beyond any doubt.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, I went out to hang out with 
friends, and the movie we happened to want 
to see was full—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"‘Shark Wind’? Does that mean sharks 
appear in stormy seas?"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend
text_block_list.text:
"Probably, right? The poster looks kinda 
scary anyway, so let's watch this one 
instead."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Yes, that's fine."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Huh?! No way!! Sharks riding the wind to 
attack us?!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, wait, wait...! Dropping in from the 
sky has to be against the rules, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
At first, I was flabbergasted by how 
absurd it was. I literally gasped, "You 
can actually do that?!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My friends were dumbfounded too, saying, 
'This has gotta be a joke, right?' But as 
for me—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I was completely captivated by that sense 
of freedom.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Sharks flying through the sky? That 
defies all common sense.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
But you know. Who was it that coined the 
word "impossible" anyway?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Sharks belong in the sea." I was the one 
who made that assumption.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What binds you the most isn't the voices 
of others. It's the "common sense" you've 
convinced yourself of.
choice_data_list:
So that's what shark movies taught you, 
huh.

So that's what shark movies taught you, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That's why I don't draw lines or set 
limits for myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The possibilities are endless. I'll show 
you I can surpass my limits with ease.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Just like a shark swimming through the 
sky, right?
choice_data_list:
I really want to learn more about shark 
movies now!

So, what kind of shark movie would you 
make?

Then what kind of shark movie would you 
make?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Just like a shark swimming through the 
sky, right?
choice_data_list:
I really want to learn more about shark 
movies now!

So, what kind of shark movie would you 
make?

Then what kind of shark movie would you 
make?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you're interested! I knew I could 
count on you!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
OK, let's start with the classics. Popcorn 
and cola, standby!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I shall escort you to the sea 
of freedom♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we ended up watching Daring 
Heart's prized shark movie.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! Sounds great! I love imagining 
things like that."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Then—where should they attack from? The 
snowy mountains? The ground? Or the 
spectator seats?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let's leave common sense behind. We'll 
come up with an exceptionally bold piece.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, for the sake of study, I sat down 
to watch the shark movies from her 
collection."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: The beach is finally open...!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, even though there are sharks in the 
sea...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"An influential figure holding an event to 
prioritize profit"... This, too, is a 
shark movie trope.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: No!! Get out of there right this second!
choice_data_list: Whaaa, a shark in the bathtub! A shark!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the metallic shark...! To 
repel even a freezing beam...!
choice_data_list: Can humanity possibly beat this shark...?
Can humanity even beat this shark...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Well, Trainer? How did it feel to be 
drenched in shark cinema?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good!! Don't worry. I have plenty more 
recommendations for you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let us relish it together to the fullest— 
the deep and profound world of shark 
movies!
